lineage.description: Census population data for the Northern Mariana Islands were spatially integrated with a 1km coastal buffer zone and a gridded population raster (PopGrid) to assess the proportion of the population living in close proximity to the coast. The analysis follows the methodology described in the peer-reviewed study on coastal proximity of populations across 22 Pacific Island Countries and Territories (Plos ONE, 2019). Village boundaries and household counts from the 2010 census serve as the primary input for the spatial analysis.
